x: A great win for John Bicourt, who beat old rivals Cope, Church and Badgery in fine style. These four were well away and a full minute separated the first and fifth runners at the finish.
TOP LEFT: Adrian Major (55) leads Church (Walton).

Badgery and Church,as expected,tore off into the lead,but Adrian ran a steadier race working his way through the field until just after the half-way mark he went into 3rd place which he held to the finish.
